scripts.build: cd apps/web && bun run build && cd ../engine && cargo build --release --lib && cd ../api && mkdir -p dist && CGO_ENABLED=1 go build -o dist/api ./cmd/api && cd ../desktop && bun run build
scripts.test: cd apps/api && CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./... && cd ../engine && cargo test && cd ../desktop/src-tauri && cargo test
scripts.lint: cd apps/web && bun run lint && cd ../../libs/types && bun run lint && cd ../../apps/api && CGO_ENABLED=1 go vet ./... && cd ../engine && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cd ../desktop/src-tauri && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.format: cd apps/web && bun run format && cd ../../libs/types && bun run format && cd ../../apps/api && gofmt -w ./cmd ./internal && cd ../engine && cargo fmt --all && cd ../desktop/src-tauri && cargo fmt --all
scripts.check: cd apps/web && bun run check && cd ../../libs/types && bun run check && cd ../../apps/api && test -z "$(gofmt -l ./cmd ./internal)" && CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./... && CGO_ENABLED=1 go vet ./... && cd ../engine && cargo check && cd ../desktop/src-tauri && cargo check
scripts.clean: cd apps/web && bun run clean && cd ../api && rm -rf dist && cd ../engine && cargo clean && cd ../desktop/src-tauri && cargo clean
